title: “Cups (Pitch Perfect's When I'm Gone)” by Anna Kendrick
text: "Cups" is a song by the American actress and singer Anna Kendrick performed in the 2012 musical comedy film Pitch Perfect. It was later released as part of the Pitch Perfect soundtrack.

title: “Holy Grail” by Jay-Z featuring Justin Timberlake
text: "Holy Grail" is a song by American rapper Jay-Z from his twelfth studio album Magna Carta Holy Grail. It features vocals from American singer Justin Timberlake and serves as the album's lead single.

title: “Scream & Shout” by Will.i.am featuring Britney Spears
text: "Scream & Shout" is a song by American rapper will.i.am and American singer Britney Spears, taken from the former's fourth studio album, #willpower. It was released on November 19, 2012, by Interscope Records as the second single from the album, and sent to mainstream radio in the United States on November 27.
